name: Datang Telecom Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Datang Telecom Technology Co., Ltd. operates in the security chip and special communication business in China. The company provides second-generation ID card chips and modules, social security card chips and modules, financial payment chips, fingerprint sensors and fingerprint algorithm chips, card reader chips, terminal security chips, and other products.
